description: The accommodation is bright, clean and perfect for a getaway with family or friends in Paris.Atypical but especially Parisian accommodation on 2 floorsThe spaceQuiet and very comfortable with a modern design, it benefits from great brightness thanks to the openings on the roof (6 Velux) and its many windows.It is a warm apartment, ideal for 2 or 3 couples, it can accommodate up to 8 people. It has a bedroom with a double bed, and a second bedroom upstairs on the mezzanine floor also including a double bed and a sofa bed. Possibility of additional sleeping in the living room with a sofa bed. We have a crib and a high chair at your disposal.Enjoy carefully selected quality furniture and plenty of storage in every room in the apartment. You have a flat-screen TV, a stereo system, and a desk with ADSL and Wi-Fi. You can adjust the heating or air-conditioning at your convenience with the remote controls.The American kitchen open to the dining area is fully equipped with glass-ceramic hobs, fridge, freezer, oven, microwave, kettle, Nespresso coffee machine, washing machines, dishwasher, as well as all the dishes and utensils necessary for cooking.In the bathroom, you have a large shower and a towel warmer. Linens are provided.Luxury atypical duplex with high ceilings (5 meters) including 2 rooms, one spacious lounge dining room, an equipped American kitchen, one bathroom, toilets, one space office, a vast dressing room. Quiet and very comfortable with a modern design, the space benefits from a lot of luminosity thanks to openings on the roof (6 roof windows) and numerous windows.It is a cozy and spacious apartment ideal for 2 or 3 couples and can welcome up to 8 people.
